epoch.description: Epoch time of the object creation

documentation.description: URI of the documentation of the object

versionorigin.description: Server-set origin of the Version id: authored from a SemVer version.instance, or generated as 0.0.0-N.

format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Description share one format

wotid.description: The WoT identifier of this Thing Description: the document's 'id' verbatim when present, or an identifier supplied by the Producer at write time otherwise. It is distinct from the client-chosen thingdescriptionid, which identifies the Resource within this Registry. All Versions share one exact wotid, including case; it MUST NOT encode a revision of the document it names.

derivedfrom.description: The authored WoT identifiers of the Thing Models this Thing Description extends or composes - authored identifiers, not xids, so a resolver matches them against the document's own references directly

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name derived from the stored Thing Description.

modelname.description: Textual model identifier derived from the stored Thing Description.

license.description: The license the document is offered under, as an SPDX license expression or a URL. Advisory provenance metadata

publisher.description: The organization that published the document. Advisory provenance metadata

standardsbody.description: The standards organization that defines or endorses the document, where one does, for example 'W3C' or 'OPC Foundation'. Advisory provenance metadata

canonicalurl.description: The canonical upstream location of the document, where it is also published outside this registry. Advisory provenance metadata

maturity.description: How established the document is, letting a Consumer prefer an official definition over an ad hoc one. Advisory provenance metadata that does not affect the semantic identity of the document

discovery.description: An observation of the stored Thing Description bytes.

url.description: The effective source URL at which the stored bytes were observed.

observedat.description: When the observer obtained the stored bytes.

observerid.description: A deployment-assigned identifier for the observing service or system.

sourcekey.description: An opaque stable source key scoped to the identified observer.
